method: WebFetch of every official course page on www.nottingham.ac.uk (start date and UK/International fee lines), cross-checked against the official "Undergraduate courses 2027/28" fee table (www.nottingham.ac.uk/fees/tuitionfees/202728/undergraduate.aspx, rows keyed by UCAS code) and the 2027/28 fee-increases page.

universityWideStatements.quote: The UK Government has confirmed that the maximum tuition fee for full time UK undergraduate and Initial Teacher Training students studying in England will increase to £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.
universityWideStatements.title: Undergraduate courses 2027/28 - The University of Nottingham
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Introduction to the 2027/28 UG fee table (table lists UK home fee £10,050 for every course in this set; international fee per row). Not used as a university-wide fee; each course is recorded from its own page.

universityWideStatements.quote: the tuition fee for your programme will be £10,050 for the 2027-28 academic year.
universityWideStatements.title: Fee increases 2027/28 - The University of Nottingham
